purpose: Resume a GitHub Actions runner that was successfully registered on REG.RU but whose bootstrap stopped before systemd, sudo-controller and authority-file materialization. Do not re-register the runner or require another token.
requiredBehavior: operate only on an already configured runner directory
never require or consume a runner registration token
decode the runner identity safely across BOM and UTF encodings
require the configured runner identity to match the production hostname-derived identity
pin the private model host by the owner-confirmed SHA256 host-key fingerprint
materialize only the restricted root controller sudo authority
install and harden the runner systemd service as pcactions
prove the running runner has no Docker supplementary group
write the redacted runner authority evidence atomically
forbiddenCapabilities: production deployment before exact-main merge and live evidence
